`ensureContainer` first observes actual state: create missing containers, start Created containers,
reuse Running containers, and apply restart policy to Exited containers. Successful init containers
stay completed; failed init containers retry unless the policy is Never. For applications, Never
keeps the result, OnFailure retries nonzero exits, and Always retries either exit code. Retried
attempts use a bounded backoff. Check image availability and pull when missing before Create/Start;
propagate errors, and use stable Pod UID/container/attempt labels to recover a lost response.

`Ensure` checks existing network state and repairs or retries missing setup; it is not an unconditional
second ADD over an already configured interface. Remove a deleted Pod's CNI state and sandbox in
retryable steps. Register the Node and periodically report capacity/Ready; an API List failure keeps
running containers intact. [The runtime contract](../docs/contracts/kubelet-runtime.md) and
[existing experiments](../docs/progress/N01-R01.md) cover these omitted helpers.
